item.title: Archive Libraries in 2026: libarchive vs SharpCompress vs Commons Compress vs archiver
item.description: Every service eventually has to accept a file the user controls. The moment that file is a .zip — a theme upload, a data import, a log bundle from a customer — you have two options: shell out to tar/unzip and inherit an argument-injection bug plus a process-per-request cost, or use a real archive library and handle the format’s edge cases deliberately.
